proposal.name: task_spec_parameter_reconciliation
proposal.trigger: When building or revising a plan from a component catalogue whose parameters carry defaults, and the task specification states any of: the population that forms a rate's denominator, a group-size or stability threshold, an explicit list of metrics or comparisons, or a presentation requirement (show numerator and denominator, cite sources, state synthetic data, describe differences as associations).
proposal.objective: Ensure that every plan parameter the task text defines is set from that text rather than left at the catalogue default, so that rate denominators, small-group thresholds, metric lists, grouping scope and report presentation match the specification and can be traced back to the phrase that required them.
procedure: Read the task objective and extract, as a checklist, every stated definition: (a) the population behind each rate's denominator (e.g. 'claims whose adjudication has concluded'), (b) any size or stability threshold (e.g. 'fewer than 30 claims'), (c) the exact metrics and the exact comparisons or groupings requested, (d) presentation requirements such as numerator/denominator display, source citations, synthetic-data and association-not-causation statements.

For every selected component, list each parameter with its catalogue default and mark it 'task-specified' or 'unspecified'. Treat a default as untrusted for any task-specified parameter: it is only kept if it equals the task's definition.

Map each extracted definition onto the option that names the same thing: the denominator option matching the task's population (e.g. adjudicated_claims, not all_claims, when the task says adjudication has concluded); min_group_size equal to the stated threshold (never 0 when a threshold is named); metrics equal to the full list the objective names; group_by equal to exactly the requested comparisons, each as its own grouping, with no unrequested composite groupings that only multiply small cells.

Set report presentation from the task wording and the claims the report will make: show_denominators=true whenever any rate is reported; cite_artifacts=true whenever a written report is a deliverable; caveats include synthetic_data always, descriptive_only and association_not_causation for any between-group comparison, and small_groups whenever min_group_size > 0 or any group can fall below the threshold.

If no catalogue option matches a stated definition exactly, choose the nearest option and state the discrepancy in the plan rationale and in the report caveats instead of silently accepting the default.
In the plan rationale write one line per non-default parameter naming the task phrase that required it, so an evaluator can trace every parameter to the specification.
required_checks: Every rate in the plan uses a denominator option whose population equals the population the task names; when the task names none, the default is used and that choice is stated.
min_group_size equals the task's stated threshold; it is 0 only when the task states no threshold.
The metrics list contains every metric the objective names; additions are justified in the rationale.
The group_by set equals the comparisons the objective requests; composite groupings appear only when requested.
show_denominators=true whenever any rate appears in the report, and cite_artifacts=true whenever report.md is a required artifact.
The caveat set includes synthetic_data, includes small_groups whenever small-group flags can be produced, and includes association_not_causation whenever groups are compared.
The plan rationale names the task phrase behind each parameter that differs from its default.
expected_artifacts: A plan whose parameters differ from the catalogue defaults wherever the task states a definition, with a rationale line mapping each override to the task text.
A group comparison output (csv/png and metrics keys) whose denominator_option and min_group_size fields match the task's definitions and whose rates carry numerator and denominator.
A report.md in which every rate is printed as numerator / denominator = rate, every results bullet cites an artifact or metrics key, and the Caveats section matches the claims made.
failure_modes: Keeping denominator=all_claims when the task defines the rate over adjudicated claims, so the rate is diluted by pending claims.
Leaving min_group_size=0 so no small-group flag is produced although the task names a stability threshold.
Requesting only the default metric subset when the objective lists more metrics, leaving required results missing.
Adding a composite grouping that was not requested, multiplying small unstable cells.
Leaving caveats empty, show_denominators=false or cite_artifacts=false because those are the defaults, so the report fails denominator, citation and caveat checks even when the numbers are right.
Choosing a caveat set that does not match the claims made, for example comparing groups without association_not_causation or flagging small groups without the small_groups caveat.
proposal.example: Task wording: 'denial rate over claims whose adjudication has concluded; show numerator and denominator for every rate; flag groups with fewer than 30 claims; present differences as associations, not causes; state that the data is synthetic.' Mapping: group_comparison.denominator=adjudicated_claims, min_group_size=30, metrics=every metric named in the objective, group_by=each requested comparison on its own; write_report.show_denominators=true, cite_artifacts=true, caveats=[synthetic_data, descriptive_only, association_not_causation, small_groups]. Each of these values differed from the catalogue default. Provenance: task T3, attempt 1 (passed 4.0/4.0, no failed checks, no evaluator feedback issued), reflection lesson 2 with the scope and caveat rule from lesson 3.
